evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We propose AnchorPrompt, an efficient adaptation method that keeps the model frozen and learns a single block of prompt vectors inserted at the decoder input, between the audio and question embeddings.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
